rule: Every lesson has at least 4 different exercise types. A lesson has 5 to 8 exercises; a review lesson has exactly 8.

cases.name: three-exercise-types
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes[0] › lessons[0]: needs at least 4 different exercise types, has 3

cases.name: four-exercises
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes[0] › lessons[0]: needs 5 to 8 exercises, has 4

cases.name: nine-exercises
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes[0] › lessons[0]: needs 5 to 8 exercises, has 9

cases.name: review-with-seven-exercises
cases.expect: unit-1.json › nodes[3]: a review lesson has exactly 8 exercises
